mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which boosts equity valuations and compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 shows no upward trend over 5 years, or 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the HOUST demand index below 1500 units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to reduced corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant relationship.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 0.7% and sustained growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 21000 billion indicates conflicting pressures: monetary easing and robust demand, which may lead to market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive despite both proxies triggering, or interaction effect rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPI inflation index below 258.1 during a late-cycle expansion signals central bank success in managing inflation, fostering investor confidence and equity market gains, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL remains above 258.1 in late-cycle periods, or 60d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the INDPRO supply index above 97.5 indicates improving production capacity and reduced supply bottlenecks, which enhances corporate earnings and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend upward above 97.5 over 5 years, or 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 0.7% and sustained growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 21000 billion indicates conflicting pressures: monetary easing and robust demand, which may lead to prolonged market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are positive despite both proxies triggering, or interaction effect rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in PAYEMS payroll numbers below 150000 indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant relationship.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock recovery regime, a sustained rise in the INDPRO supply index above 97.5 indicates resolving production constraints, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend above 97.5 in supply shock recovery periods, or 60d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).
